author: evac
description: Ambient anime-character card collecting. Cards drop as the channel talks; a random claim emoji is burned onto each card's art, so you have to actually look at each card (not just react fastest) to claim it. Collect, trade, sell duplicates for wondercoin, and build a gallery.
install_msg: Thanks for installing cardcollect! Set a drop channel with `.card setchannel #channel`, then bulk-import a starter character pool with `.card importpool <count>` (pulls female AniList characters spread across rarity tiers to match drop_weights, not just the most-favourited ones; safe to re-run, it skips characters already in the pool, paces its own requests, and retries automatically if AniList rate-limits it -- but only run one `.card importpool` at a time, a second one just queues behind the first) or add your own one at a time with `.card addcard`. Turn on `.card testmode true` and try `.card testdrop` before going live -- test claims run the full mechanic but award nothing. Members get a daily claim quota (`.card set claimquota`, default 10/day, 0 = unlimited), a `.card info <card>` lookup, and up to 3 showcase slots (`.card showcase add/remove`) in their gallery -- `.card` and `.card showcase` also take an optional @member to view someone else's. Each member can hold one tradeable spare of any character (a second copy, giftable with `.card give`); a 3rd claim of the same card auto-converts to a sell token instead of piling up duplicates. Run `.card diagnostics` after a few days live to get real sizing suggestions for drop_chance/drop_cooldown_seconds instead of guessing.
short: Ambient anime-character card collecting with an emoji-search claim mechanic.
name: cardcollect
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per member, their card collection, favorite card, and pending sell tokens. This data is stored locally in the bot's data folder and is not shared externally.
